stemMd: A plane cuts a cube parallel to one of its faces and passes through its interior. What shape is the cross-section?
explanationMd: A face-parallel plane intersects the four perpendicular side faces at equal distances from the corresponding edges. The section is congruent in shape and size to a face: a square.

distractorRationale.b: The stated parallel orientation gives four equal sides.
distractorRationale.a: That can arise for a different oblique cut, not this one.
distractorRationale.e: A plane section of this polyhedron has straight edges.
distractorRationale.c: A face-parallel section intersects four side faces.
